### Fixed

- *(model-serving)* Every preset served from a model image sets USER, LOGNAME and TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR — the predictor runs as the modelcar uid 1010, which llm-d-cuda v0.8.0's passwd does not know, and vLLM's import died in torch's inductor cache-dir lookup on every new preset ([#591](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/591)) in [#604](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/604) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v4.47.0...v4.47.1
